title: Segmentation fault when upgrading from `v1.0.0` to `v1.1.0`
body:
### What happens?

While upgrading our `duckdb` runtime from `v1.0.0` to `v1.1.0`, we are getting a segfault : 

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6f4d27f5-7477-4e9c-af17-baac162ef23f)

Our script is used through a cli command `duckdb` and uses a lot of `.read` statements into `duck.sql` sql file:

```sql
.read sql/load_node_country.sql
.read sql/load_node_gh_repository.sql
.read sql/load_node_gh_team.sql
```

then we load the file this way : 

```sh
duckdb data-quality.duckdb < duck.sql
````

When we play the sql files manually it works, but when we do the cli ways ot breks with a segfault.

ℹ️ Reverting to `v1.0.0` makes things run as usual.

### To Reproduce

We are trying to produce an example data set with publically available data.

### OS:

Ubuntu 22.04 & 24.04

### DuckDB Version:

v1.1.1

### DuckDB Client:

duckdb cli

### Hardware:

N/A

### Full Name:

Adrien SALES

### Affiliation:

https://dev.to/reporter/

### What is the latest build you tested with? If possible, we recommend testing with the latest nightly build.

I have tested with a stable release

Hi @reporter thanks for opening this and working on a reproducer. You can try to build a `relassert` build of DuckDB. The main build instructions are here: https://duckdb.org/docs/dev/building/build_instructions

Use `relassert` as a build goal and adjust the list of extensions according to your used extensions:

```bash
CORE_EXTENSIONS='autocomplete;icu;parquet;json;spatial' GEN=ninja make relassert
```

Then, you should be able to use the `build/relassert/duckdb` binary for more information. This will be somewhat slower than the release binaries though. HTH.

If you're on Ubuntu and can install packages with `apt-get`, I recommend building it from source, it's really just a few lines:

```bash
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git g++ cmake ninja-build libssl-dev
git clone https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb
cd duckdb
CORE_EXTENSIONS='autocomplete;icu;parquet;json;spatial' GEN=ninja make relassert
```

Are you on x86_64 (amd64) or aarch64 (arm64)?

comments.author: participant3
comments.body:
> It appears that removing PRIMARY KEY statement on two columns removes the segfault

Hi @reporter - what are the data types of your indexed columns in your data set? I am asking because their combined size might exceed the (previous, `v.1.0.0`) prefix length of 15 bytes. In that case, it is likely that your issue is related to https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/13858.

If so, it would be helpful if you could rerun your reproduction once we have a nightly pre-release available with the fixes in https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/13858.
